name: How do you prevent mold after a flood?

mainEntity.name: How do you prevent mold after a flood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold after a flood requires rapid and thorough drying. Our process includes immediate water extraction, using industrial-grade dehumidifiers and air movers to quickly reduce moisture levels in the air and materials. We also apply antimicrobial treatments to affected surfaces. Complete drying within 24-48 hours is critical, as mold can begin to grow rapidly in moist conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: We prevent mold after a flood by rapid water extraction, industrial-grade drying, and antimicrobial treatments, focusing on drying within 24-48 hours.
